select name,count(name) as count from dc_report_desion_censor_view where name is not null
and date_format(censon_begin_date,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(censon_end_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by name,keywords
having keywords= #{keywords}

select name,count(name) as count from dc_report_desion_censor_view where name is not null
and date_format(censon_begin_date,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(censon_end_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by name,keywords having keywords not in ('深水', '深水岩下', '陆地盐膏层','油砂','大位移','高温高压')

select name,count(name) as count from dc_report_desion_censor_view where name is not null
and date_format(censon_begin_date,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(censon_end_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by name

select YEAR(CENSON_END_DATE) as year ,count(*) as count from dc_report_desion_censor where 1=1
and date_format(censon_begin_date,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(censon_end_date,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by YEAR(CENSON_END_DATE)
select name,keywords from dc_report_desion_censor_view where name is not null group by name ,keywords
